expectations.note: Different-folder jump action was activated successfully and the candidate captured a post-action screenshot after invoking scroll-to-track.
The shipped visibility predicate compares only parent folders and never uses isTrackVisible for a same-folder playing track, so the core off-screen case is not exposed.
A playing track in the current folder does not expose the jump action when its row is visible.
Final runtime had isPlaying false and songInfo null, with no jump action in semantics.
The active affordance is a labeled semantics button and the session tapped its action successfully.
Before-state screenshots were captured and reviewed while the target row was outside the visible browser region.
An after-state screenshot was captured and reviewed following the jump action.
Events support play, tap, and screenshot claims, but the stronger same-folder claim lacks a supporting state observation.
The app remained usable, but the session did not complete a full on-screen navigation and next/previous regression sweep.
Final runtime remained responsive and reported zero overflow or error reports.
